# FLUX.2 KLEIN — PHOTO RESTORATION PROMPTS (v6, final — based on real proven examples)

Klein preserves everything you don't mention by default. Real working prompts from the field are 1-2 short sentences. Keep it that simple.


================================================================================
1. OLD BLACK & WHITE RESTORATION
================================================================================

Restore and sharpen this old black-and-white photo. Remove scratches, dust, stains, and noise. Keep the likeness of every face unchanged. Keep it black and white — do not colorize.

================================================================================
2. OLD PHOTO NATURAL COLORIZATION
================================================================================

Restore and naturally colorize this old photo. Remove scratches, dust, stains, and noise, and add realistic natural colors to the skin, hair, clothing, and background. Keep the likeness of every face unchanged.

================================================================================
3. OLD PHOTO MODERN CAMERA RESTORATION
================================================================================

Restore this old photo to modern photo quality. Remove scratches, noise, and blur, fix the white balance and exposure, and sharpen the details. Keep the likeness of every face unchanged.

================================================================================
4. FULL SCENE BACKGROUND RECONSTRUCTION & COLORIZATION
================================================================================

Restore and colorize this old photo, including reconstructing any damaged or faded parts of the background so the whole scene looks complete and natural. Keep the likeness of every face unchanged.

================================================================================
5. BLURRY / LOW-RESOLUTION PHOTO RESTORATION
================================================================================

Sharpen this blurry, low-resolution photo. Remove noise and pixelation and recover natural detail. Keep the likeness of every face and the scene unchanged — don't invent new details.

after this u can upscale with seedvr 2 for micro details
